biomarkers.name: TP53 / del(17p)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse; supports use of targeted therapy rather than chemoimmunotherapy in practice

biomarkers.name: MYC rearrangements
biomarkers.clinical_use: May support aggressive biology, but is not by itself diagnostic and does not reliably distinguish from CLL

biomarkers.name: Immunophenotype (CD5+/CD19+/CD20 bright/sIg bright, CD23 variable)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports distinction from typical CLL/SLL (which more often shows dim CD20/sIg), but overlap exists and exclusion of mantle cell lymphoma is essential

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Large lymphocytes (prolymphocytes — >55% of blood lymphs by historical definition) with prominent central nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
variants: historical de novo B-PLL / splenic B-cell leukemia with prominent nucleoli
prolymphocytic transformation of CLL (more common — de novo B-PLL is very rare and modern classification no longer fully retains classic B-PLL as a distinct entity)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; targeted therapy paradigm increasingly used in practice
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Splenomegaly without significant lymphadenopathy is characteristic

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature B cells (though the category has been reduced in modern classification, with many historical cases reclassified as CLL prolymphocytic transformation, leukemic mantle cell lymphoma, or splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Prolymphocytic differentiation with large lymphocytes (prolymphocytes — >55% of blood lymphocytes by historical definition) with prominent central nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Prolymphocytic transformation of CLL represents progression from mature small B cells to larger prolymphocytes; TP53 alterations are common and associated with aggressive biology; MYC rearrangements are reported in a subset
